title: Measure indexing, delivery capacity and operating cost
objective: Runtime and storage choices are justified by current-cardinality measurements.
outcome: Named workload and cost ceilings exist before measurement. A small fixture or warm-only average cannot qualify cold starts or production capacity. Output parity remains exact. Browser time, edge/network latency and upstream collection remain distinguished. No source acquisition happens during a user search. C-009-1 remains unresolved without actual account terms, shared allowances, measured steady/burst workload and cost, storage/transfer, and unchanged rights/capacity/recovery constraints. Public prices and publication asset lengths alone are insufficient. Owner budget deferral is neither a zero-dollar cap nor proof of a cheapest topology. Sealed packages/search remains unmodified. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged. HTTP 200 is not a completed research task.

commits.subject: Define the real workload and budgets
commits.instructions: Pin corpus/dictionary sizes, query mix, cold/warm definitions, concurrency, regions, response sizes and source-job contention. Compare existing deployment requirements with proposed SLOs explicitly.
commits.verification: No accepted old performance gate is silently weakened; targets and cost ceilings are named before measurement.

commits.subject: Benchmark bounded indexed delivery
commits.instructions: Measure actual candidate query/detail/variables/MRF metadata paths at current and twice planned load. Profile memory/CPU/storage/asset counts and compare any proposed index/cache topology.
commits.verification: A small fixture or warm-only average cannot qualify cold starts or production capacity; output parity remains exact.

commits.subject: Choose and document the measured topology
commits.instructions: Retain the lowest-cost option satisfying quality, capacity and rollback requirements. Prepare any required ADR/procurement change with evidence instead of assuming premium infrastructure.
commits.verification: Report steady and burst costs, provider fees, storage and review operations; failed targets remain unresolved until fixed. Include an explicit disposition of PR009/C-009-1 measured-topology qualification using actual account terms/shared allowances, measured steady/burst workload and cost, storage/transfer, and unchanged rights/capacity/recovery constraints. Public prices and publication asset lengths alone are insufficient. Owner budget deferral is neither a zero-dollar cap nor proof of a cheapest topology. Keep C-009-1 unresolved if its required evidence is absent.
